signals.text: Revenue grew 1% a year over 3 years vs 10% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 2% vs revenue at 1%: profit is tracking sales.
Operating margin expanded 68 bps in 3 years (18.2% → 18.8%).
Working-capital days shortened by 16 days in 3 years (54 → 38).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 109% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

guidance.quote: overall, we have given our direction that we should stay in the volume region of about 8-10%. ... At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.

guidance.statement: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18% to 20% of our PBDIT margins holds.

delivered.statement: Overall, decorative volume growth was at a strong 9% for Q1.
Decorative value grew at 16.6% in Q1.
Standalone PBDIT margin was strong at 22%.
Consolidated PBDIT margins stood at 20.6%, almost 240 bps higher YoY.
International business grew at about 27% in Q1.
New products within the portfolio contributed 17% of overall revenues.

calls.tone: Confident on demand recovery and premiumization, but cautious about raw material cost volatility and competitive intensity.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned if 9% volume growth is sufficient given the soft base and preponement of demand due to price hikes.
Analysts probed why industrial segment PBT margins declined and when they would normalize.
Analysts questioned the correlation between crude levels, input costs, and maintaining the 18-20% margin guidance.
Analysts queried the breakdown of the value-volume gap and whether negative mix assumptions need revisiting.

business.summary: Asian Paints beautifies, transforms, and preserves spaces and objects. It operates primarily in decorative paints, home decor, industrial coatings, and international markets, driving growth through innovation, premiumization, services, regionalization, B2B expansion, and backward integration.

segments.name: Decorative Paints
segments.note: Core business focusing on premiumization and innovations.

segments.name: Industrial Business
segments.note: Includes PPGAP (Auto OE) and General Industrial.

segments.name: International Business
segments.note: Operations across Middle East, Africa, Asia.

guidance.statement: We are looking at commissioning the first phase of the Dahej VAM-VAE project in the next quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at commissioning the first phase of this project in the next quarter.

delivered.statement: Consolidated Net Sales stood at 35,516 crores, representing a growth of 5.1%.
Consolidated Operating Margins (PBDIT margins) expanded to 18.9% from 17.8% in the previous year.
Net Profit after minority interest grew by 17.9% to 4,325 crores.
Total dividend for FY 2025-26 recommended at 27.50 per equity share, representing an 11% increase.
New products contributed approximately 16% of overall revenues during the year.
Expanded distribution network by adding nearly 6,000 new retail touchpoints.

calls.tone: confident on market leadership and strategic investments, cautious on competitive intensity and raw material headwinds

pushback.gist: Analysts and shareholders questioned how the company plans to face aggressive competition from new entrants like Birla Opus.
Questions raised regarding potential margin compression due to volatile crude prices, energy costs, and currency depreciation.
Queries raised on the increase in promoter share pledging and the significant rise in the Managing Director's remuneration.
Concerns regarding the underperformance and impairment losses recognized on home decor acquisitions like White Teak.

guidance.statement: Achieve high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8% to 10% going forward.
guidance.quote: we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.

guidance.statement: Maintain margin guidance within the band of 18% to 20% going forward.
guidance.quote: we are trying to see that we get into that area of 8-10% volume growth. Excellent, Amit. Thank you so much. Excellent set of results. Congratulations once again. ... We are maintaining our margin guidance, which is there.

guidance.statement: Expect to commission the first phase of the VAM-VAE backward integration project in the first half of this year.
guidance.quote: We expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.

guidance.statement: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative given infrastructure investments and government spending.
guidance.quote: Industrial coatings will continue to grow much higher than decorative, given the investment happening in the infrastructure and Government spending that is happening in this area.

guidance.statement: International business is expected to continue to grow and contribute strongly to growth.
guidance.quote: International business again is expected to continue to grow and therefore, both industrial and international will strongly contribute to our growth going forward, as far as Q1 is concerned.

delivered.statement: Decorative business achieved 12.4% volume growth and 10.2% value growth in Q4.
Full coatings volume growth reached 12.7% and value growth reached 11% in Q4.
Full year volume growth was close to 9% with 4.3% value growth at the standalone level.
Gross margins reached an all-time high of about 45.6% for Q4.
New products contributed a substantial 17% of revenues during the year.
Declared a final dividend of Rs. 23 per share, totaling Rs. 27.5 per share for the year with a 60% payout ratio.

calls.tone: confident on demand and volume momentum, cautious on geopolitical volatility, inflation, and pricing margins.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether price hikes fully cover cost inflation and currency depreciation, and how margins will be protected.
Analysts probed if discounting and competitive intensity remain high despite inflationary pressures and recent price hikes.
Questions were raised on whether Q4/Q1 volumes were driven by dealer upstocking ahead of price hikes rather than true demand.
Pressed on why margins won't contract sharply like they did in the FY22 crude inflation cycle.

guidance.statement: We target volume growth in the 8% to 10% band for Q4.
guidance.quote: band of 8- 10% for volume and gap between the volume and the value is a good indicator

guidance.statement: We endeavour to maintain PBDIT margins within the 18% to 20% band.
guidance.quote: I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead

guidance.statement: We are gunning to train almost 10 lakh people in skilling processes this year.
guidance.quote: this year, as we kind of go ahead, we are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people.

delivered.statement: Delivered high single-digit decorative volume growth of 7.9% in Q3 FY26.
Standalone net sales grew by 2.9% and decorative value growth was 2.8% in Q3.
Standalone gross margin expanded by 200 bps year-on-year to reach 44.9% in Q3.
PBDIT margin came in strong at 21.4%, up 100 bps year-on-year in Q3.
PPGAP JV delivered a stellar performance with volume growth of nearly 17% in Q3.

calls.tone: Cautiously optimistic on demand recovery, confident in volume momentum, market leadership, and strong cost efficiencies.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why paint industry growth remains muted despite market leadership and new entrants' promotional spends.
Pressed on whether the 4% to 5% volume-value gap will persist indefinitely without narrowing.
Asked about the strategy on pricing given competitor price hikes and Asian Paints' high margins.

credibility.line: Management delivers on specific targets but faces persistent analyst skepticism regarding demand sustainability and competitive pressures.
